== Facsimile image and printed wording (Story 773) ==
The article's game text is unchanged. Its former image, [[:File:Dag-R-L-sonofskywalker.jpg]], differs from that wording, including “anything he pilots” and the deploy-phase lightsaber sentence. The new [[:File:Dagobah-Revised-L-sonofskywalker-facsimile.png|Wiki-made white-border facsimile]] uses the 4 September 2001 Decipher.com black-border GIF and the clean white-border illustration in Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2, PDF p. 38<ref name="facsimile-book-p38">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=38 Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], PDF p. 38.</ref> as its printed-content witness. The illustration matches the checked wording, lore, statistics, icons and copyright; it is not an authenticated Decipher white-border scan or a verified physical-card photo. The crop, border mask and whole-face resampling are recorded on the File page. Existing identifiers, other printed fields and family navigation are unchanged. The former File is retained. == Physical white-border wording correction ==
A readable physical white-border specimen in the [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 PSA collector gallery] ([https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/179117643/qARmcotEKkCgVwV4vP6iuw.jpg front photograph]) says “anything he pilots” and “during your deploy phase”, with deployment “on Luke (for free)” and “reshuffle”. The older black-border publisher GIF and the white-border book illustration used for the preceding facsimile have different words; they do not establish the wording of this photographed physical specimen. The replacement image is an explicitly cropped/downsampled photograph with no altered printed words. The November 1998 [[:File:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Glossary 2.0]], PDF p.120, independently contains the same updated wording; it is cited as documentary context, not physical proof. Existing identifiers and navigation are unchanged. This observation does not establish every printing or its first release date.
